```{r setup-colors, include=FALSE}
# Define consistent color schemes across all plots

condition_colors <- c(
  "Reference-based CPU" = "#E41A1C",  # red
  "Reference-based GPU" = "#377EB8",  # blue
  "POA-based CPU"        = "#4DAF4A",  # green
  "POA-based GPU"        = "#984EA3"   # purple
)

reads_palette <- c(
  "10" = "#E69F00",
  "20" = "#56B4E9",
  "30" = "#009E73",
  "50" = "#F0E442"
)

add_consistent_colors <- function(aesthetic = "fill", var = "condition") {
  if (var == "condition") {
    if (aesthetic == "fill") return(scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors))
    else return(scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors))
  } else if (var == "reads") {
    if (aesthetic == "fill") return(scale_fill_manual(values = reads_palette))
    else return(scale_color_manual(values = reads_palette))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(flextable)
library(scales)
library(officer)
library(patchwork)
```

# Functions

```{r}
# Function to read a trace file and add configuration info
read_trace_file <- function(path) {
  folder <- basename(dirname(path))
  
  read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    separate(process, c("pipeline", "workflow", "process", "label"), sep = ":| ", fill = "right") %>%
    mutate(
      config_folder = folder,
      sample = str_extract(folder, "sample[0-9]+"),
      sample_num = as.numeric(str_remove(sample, "sample")),
      mode = ifelse(str_detect(folder, "gpu-true"), "GPU", "CPU"),
      polishing = ifelse(str_detect(folder, "ref-true"), "Reference-based", "POA-based"), 
      duration = as.character(duration),
      exit = as.character(exit),
      start = ymd_hms(start),
      complete = ymd_hms(complete),
      duration_sec = as.numeric(difftime(complete, start, units = "secs")),
      sample = factor(sample, levels = unique(sample[order(sample_num)])),
      condition = paste( mode, polishing ),
      condition_order = case_when(
        str_detect(condition, "GPU Reference-based") ~ 1,
        str_detect(condition, "CPU Reference-based") ~ 2,
        str_detect(condition, "GPU POA-based") ~ 3,
        str_detect(condition, "CPU POA-based") ~ 4
      )
    )
}
```

# Paths

```{r}
# Load all trace.txt files
trace_paths <- list.files(
  path = "scalability/nextflow_stats",
  pattern = "trace.txt",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

# Load data

```{r}
trace_data <- 
  lapply(trace_paths, read_trace_file) %>% 
  bind_rows()

```

# Parse tables

```{r}
# Parse start and complete times and calculate duration
trace_data_parsed <- trace_data %>% 
  filter(sample_num < 192)
```

# Runtime per process

```{r}
## 1. Process-level summary
duration_summary <- 
  trace_data_parsed %>%
  group_by(polishing, mode, sample, process) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tasks = n(),
    mean_duration = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration = median(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_duration = sd(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Table

```{r}
publication_table_duration_summary <- flextable(duration_summary %>%
                                                  arrange(sample, polishing, mode, process) %>%
                                                  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 2))) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_caption("Execution time per process (seconds)") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "all") %>% 
  theme_zebra() %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%  
  border_inner_v(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5)) %>%
  border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5))

doc_duration_summary <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(publication_table_duration_summary)

print(doc_duration_summary, target = "scalability/out/SuppTable_duration_summary.docx")

```

## Plot

```{r}
p.runtime_per_process <- 
  duration_summary %>% 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = process, 
      y = median_duration, 
      fill = mode
    )
  )+
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  facet_grid(polishing ~ sample, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Process", 
    y = "Median Duration [s]", 
    fill = "Mode"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
  )

ggsave(
  plot = p.runtime_per_process,
  filename = "runtime_per_process.jpeg",
  path = "scalability/out/",
  width = 12, height = 9
)

```

# Runtime normalized per task

```{r}
runtime_per_task <- trace_data_parsed %>%
  mutate(
    duration = as.numeric(difftime(complete, start, units = "secs"))
  ) %>% 
  group_by(polishing, mode, sample, sample_num, process) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    total_runtime_sec = sum(duration),
    total_runtime_sec_normalized = total_runtime_sec / n,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na()
```

## Table

```{r}
table_runtime_per_task <- runtime_per_task %>%
  arrange(sample, polishing, mode, process) %>%
  mutate(
    total_runtime_sec = round(total_runtime_sec, 2),
    total_runtime_sec_normalized = round(total_runtime_sec_normalized, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    "Samples [n]" = sample_num,
    Polishing = polishing,
    Mode = mode,
    Process = process,
    `Total Runtime [s]` = total_runtime_sec,
    `Normalized Runtime [s/task]` = total_runtime_sec_normalized,
    `Number of Tasks` = n
  )

# Create flextable
publication_table_runtime_per_task <- flextable(table_runtime_per_task) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_caption("Total and normalized pipeline runtime per process and configuration") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "all") %>%
  theme_zebra() %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%
  border_inner_v(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5)) %>%
  border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5))

# Save to Word
doc_runtime_per_task <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(publication_table_runtime_per_task)

print(doc_runtime_per_task, target = "scalability/out/SuppTable_runtime_per_task.docx")

```

# Total and normalized runtime

```{r}
## 2. Total runtime per condition
total_runtime <- trace_data_parsed %>%
  group_by(polishing, mode, sample, sample_num, condition_order) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(start, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_time = max(complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    total_runtime_sec = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start, units = "secs")),
    total_runtime_sec_normalized = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start, units = "secs")) / n,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Predict missing datapoints

```{r}
#  Predict missing sample sizes up to 192 

# Define all target sample sizes up to 192
all_samples <- data.frame(sample_num = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 96))

predicted_missing <- total_runtime %>%
  group_by(polishing, mode) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    present <- unique(.x$sample_num)
    missing <- setdiff(all_samples$sample_num, present)
    if (length(missing) == 0) return(tibble())
    
    fit <- lm(log(total_runtime_sec) ~ log(sample_num), data = .x)
    preds <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(sample_num = missing), interval = "confidence")
    
    tibble(
      sample_num = missing,
      total_runtime_sec = exp(preds[, "fit"]),
      lwr = exp(preds[, "lwr"]),
      upr = exp(preds[, "upr"]),
      estimate = coef(fit)[["log(sample_num)"]],
      type = "Predicted"
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Label observed data
observed <- total_runtime %>%
  select(polishing, mode, sample_num, total_runtime_sec, condition_order) %>%
  mutate(type = "Observed")

# Combine observed + predicted
runtime_complete <- bind_rows(observed, predicted_missing)


n_cluster <- 
  total_runtime %>% 
  select(polishing, sample_num, n) %>% 
  distinct()

# Recompute normalized runtime for observed + predicted
runtime_complete_norm <- runtime_complete %>%
  group_by(polishing, mode, sample_num) %>%
  left_join(n_cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    total_runtime_sec_normalized = total_runtime_sec / n
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# - Table of predictions -
table_runtime_complete <- runtime_complete_norm %>%
  arrange(polishing, mode, sample_num) %>%
  mutate(
    total_runtime_sec = round(total_runtime_sec, 2),
    total_runtime_sec_normalized = round(total_runtime_sec_normalized, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Polishing = polishing,
    Mode = mode,
    `Samples [n]` = sample_num,
    `Clusters [n]` = n,
    `Type` = type,
    `Total Runtime [s]` = total_runtime_sec,
    `Normalized Runtime [s/task]` = total_runtime_sec_normalized
  )

publication_table_runtime_complete <- flextable(table_runtime_complete) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_caption("Observed and predicted total and normalized pipeline runtime per configuration") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "all") %>%
  theme_zebra() %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%
  border_inner_v(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5)) %>%
  border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color = "grey60", width = 0.5))

# Save to Word
doc_runtime_complete <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(publication_table_runtime_complete)

print(doc_runtime_complete, target = "scalability/out/SuppTable_runtime_combined_complete.docx")
```

### Complete

```{r}
colors <- 
  c(
    "CPU POA-based" = "#E64B35",
    "GPU POA-based" = "#4DBBD5",
    "CPU Reference-based" = "#00A087",
    "GPU Reference-based" = "#3C5488"
  )

# - Plot observed + predicted -
p_runtime_complete <- runtime_complete %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = sample_num,
    y = total_runtime_sec,
    color = paste(mode, polishing),
    shape = type
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = type)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Samples [n]",
    y = "Total Runtime [s]",
    color = "Condition",
    shape = "Data type",
    linetype = "Data type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),   # legend for color in 2 rows
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),   # optional if you want shape legend also in 2 rows
    linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) # optional if you want linetype legend also in 2 rows
  )

ggsave(
  plot = p_runtime_complete,
  filename = "p_runtime_complete.jpeg",
  path = "scalability/out/",
  width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 600
)

```

### patchwork

```{r}
design_runtime_no_facet <- "AB"

# Combine with patchwork, label A/B
pw_runtime_no_facet <- 
  wrap_plots(
    A = p_runtime_complete, 
    B = p_normalized_runtime_no_facet_complete, 
    design = design_runtime_no_facet
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
  ) +
  plot_layout(
    axes = "collect",
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
